real-pr-complement-property.statement: Real finite-dimensional magnitude phase retrieval modulo sign is injective exactly under the complement property. Squaring preserves injectivity, not metric stability constants.
real-pr-complement-property.source: Bandeira, Cahill, Mixon, Nelson, Saving phase, Theorem 3

intensity-origin-degeneracy.statement: Intensity and amplitude have different stable metrics; the intensity map has quadratic scaling at zero while the natural signal quotient metric has linear scaling.
intensity-origin-degeneracy.source: Balan and Zou, On Lipschitz Analysis and Lipschitz Synthesis for the Phase Retrieval Problem, Proposition 3.1(iv)

two-support-union.statement: Two explanations with q arbitrary corrupted coordinates can disagree on up to 2q coordinates; a shared clean subset has size at least m-2q.
two-support-union.source: Generic coding/support-union argument, project proof v4/THEORY T1; URL is related PR injectivity source, not a priority citation for support union.
